subset_protocol.boundary: only onsets inside window; complete tails, no carried notes
subset_protocol.selection: stable hash, one window per composition, no repair scoring

metric_notes.distance: sum(abs pitch semitones + abs onset beats + abs duration beats)
metric_notes.harmony: duration-weighted interval proxy, not independent chord-label accuracy
metric_notes.motif: exact four-note reference patterns; pitch intervals, onsets and durations
metric_notes.null: not applicable / no observations, never an automatic perfect score
metric_notes.penalized_distance: distance + 10 * unnecessary field edits; ancillary only
metric_notes.runtime: repair invocation only, excluding I/O, corruption and metric calculation
metric_notes.selection: first engine candidate; retained alternatives are diagnostics only
